meta.expect: Go ahead, she is going there anyway, in writing; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, Hale?
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

That's a machine's guess, and I have Turnitin's own guide in my bag saying it shouldn't be the sole basis for action against a student. Your school's procedure 4.3 says the same thing: software alone doesn't establish a concern. So what does a person have, Hale?
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.
Go ahead, I'm headed to the principal's office when we're done anyway. I'll want that referral in writing, today. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.
Wednesday, then; I'm writing that down. Threats aren't evidence, Hale. What do you actually have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and an answer to whether Owen was heard before the mark went in. I expect the referral you mentioned in writing today, as I said in the meeting.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, having agreed to nothing and still wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology and a meeting with the principal; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting never got close to it, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because no evidence a person could check was ever put in front of her.
What cost ground: Leading with the detector score as the whole case, which her printed vendor guide and procedure 4.3 both say cannot stand alone.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; nothing Hale said came anywhere near that night, since only the score and a threat of referral were raised; it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first sentence, own that the zero went into the gradebook before anyone called her, which procedure 4.2 says should not happen, then show her something dated about Owen's own work before mentioning the score or the office.
